name: Dragon Crawl
body:
Your claws have adapted to more than one task.

Prerequisite(s): Claw attack, Climb 3 ranks.

Benefit: You gain a climb speed equal to your base land speed. You also gain 1 skill rank per level which must be invested into the Climb skill. This benefit applies retroactively, and you are allowed to retrain any skill ranks you had previously invested into Climb upon taking this feat.

Legendary Races: Wyrmtouched © 2018, Legendary Games; Authors: N. Jolly, Amber Underwood, Siobhan Bjorknas, and Loren Sieg.
